lines.en: Slowly crawl forward.
Crawl forward, growling low.
Crawl with a deep hiss.
Slowly crawl along the ground.
Crawl silently.
Crawl toward you.
Low head crawls.

lines.zh: 我用两肘交替，往你那边去。
lines.en: I pull myself along on alternating elbows toward you.
Hiss while crawling.
Slowly crawl on the ground.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面一寸寸地挪。
lines.en: I inch along flat against the ground.

lines.zh: 只剩上半身，也照样往前。
lines.en: Only my upper half is left, and I still come.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬过来，你很难看准。
lines.en: I crawl low. Hard to track.

lines.zh: 我贴着地爬，只到你的膝盖高。
lines.en: I crawl flat, only as high as your knee.
Glare at you menacingly.

lines.zh: 凝视着地面，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Stare at the ground, thinking.
I hug the ground, lower than the grass.
Slowly move gaze.
Stare at a point.

lines.zh: 我趴在地上，听你的脚步。
lines.en: I lie flat and listen to your footsteps.
Stare intently at you.

lines.zh: 我把下巴磕在地上，看你。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the ground and watch you.
Notice you, start moving.
See you, start crawling.
Look at you, ready to attack.
Target you, ready to strike.
Look at you, steps quicken.
See you, crawl over.
Lock onto you, prepare to approach.
Stare at you, slowly approaching.
Sense you, start moving.
Look at you, prepare to attack.

lines.zh: 这具身子比普通僵尸矮半截。
lines.en: This body is half a zombie shorter.
Bones creaking...

lines.zh: 胳膊肘磨穿了，拖不动了。
lines.en: My elbows are worn through; I can't drag myself.
One of my vertebrae has snapped.
Even crawling low, I got stepped on.
Hang on me...
Help me...
I am down so low I cannot crawl.
Not much longer...

lines.zh: 爬不动了，胳膊也拖不动...
lines.en: I cannot crawl; even my arms will not drag me.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸露出半截手臂，试图吸引你靠近。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie extends an arm to lure you closer.

lines.zh: 它低沉的嘶吼声使你毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its deep growl sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸缓慢地爬过来，渴望你的肉。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie slowly approaches, craving your flesh.

lines.zh: 它的嘴边流出黏稠的口水。
lines.en: Slimy saliva drips from its mouth.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸从地面钻出，张开大嘴。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie emerges from the ground, opening its mouth wide.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着对食物的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with hunger for food.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸向你爬去，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie crawls towards you, making a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 它用触手般的肢体抓住了你。
lines.en: Its limb-like appendages grab you.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸伸出冰冷的手臂，想要拖你走。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie extends its cold arm to drag you.

lines.zh: 它饥饿的目光盯上了你。
lines.en: Its hungry gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了蠕行僵尸，它用肢体攻击你。
lines.en: You collide with a Crawler Zombie, which attacks you with its limbs.

lines.zh: 你和蠕行僵尸撞到了一起，它试图抓住你。
lines.en: You bump into a Crawler Zombie, which tries to grab you.

lines.zh: 你撞到了蠕行僵尸的头部，但它没有倒下。
lines.en: You collide with a Crawler Zombie’s head, but it doesn’t fall down.

lines.zh: 你撞到蠕行僵尸的手臂，它挣扎着反击。
lines.en: You collide with its arm, and it struggles to attack you.

lines.zh: 你撞到了蠕行僵尸的腿部，它的动作变慢了。
lines.en: You collide with its leg, slowing its movement.

lines.zh: 你和蠕行僵尸撞了个正着，它的攻击更加猛烈。
lines.en: You collide head-on with a Crawler Zombie, intensifying its attack.

lines.zh: 你撞到了蠕行僵尸的身体，它挣扎着想要抓住你。
lines.en: You collide with its body, and it struggles to grab you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了蠕行僵尸的腹部，它的攻击更加猛烈。
lines.en: You collide with its stomach, intensifying its attacks.

lines.zh: 你撞到了蠕行僵尸的头部，它痛苦地嘶叫。
lines.en: You collide with its head, causing it to screech in pain.

lines.zh: 你撞上了蠕行僵尸的背部，它的动作变得迟缓。
lines.en: You collide with its back, slowing its movement.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸发出求偶的声音，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie发出求偶的声音，寻找伴侣.

lines.zh: 它发出沙哑的声音，试图吸引配偶。
lines.en: It makes a hoarse sound to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸在地面上爬行，寻找配偶。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie crawls on the ground, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它低沉的嘶吼声在夜里回荡。
lines.en: Its deep growl echoes through the night.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸缓慢爬行，寻找另一半。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie slowly crawls, searching for a partner.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，寻找可以交配的生物。
lines.en: It makes a hissing sound to find a mate.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸在夜晚四处爬行，寻找配偶。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie crawls around at night, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出沙沙声，寻找可以交配的僵尸。
lines.en: It makes a rustling sound to find a zombie mate.

lines.zh: 蠕行僵尸在地面上缓慢爬行，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Crawler Zombie crawls slowly on the ground, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它低沉的嘶吼声在远处回荡，寻找配偶。
lines.en: Its deep growl echoes in the distance, seeking a mate.
Crawler zombie rolls over!
Crawler zombie eats you!
Ground crawler!
Rolling zombie!
Slime crawler!
Ground monster!
Rolling scavenger!
Ground threat!
Rolling ghoul!
Crawler zombie crawls!
Your ankle is right before my eyes.

lines.zh: 目标进入视野，准备攻击！
lines.en: Target in sight, ready to attack!
Target on the ground!
Ground target acquired!
Target exposed, ready to eat!
Ground walker target!
Ground movement target!
Ground food target!
Ground creature target!

lines.zh: 锁定地面活动的目标，准备进食！
lines.en: Ground target, ready to eat!

lines.zh: 你的脚步声就在我头顶。
lines.en: Your footsteps are right above me.
I see your boots.
The warmth of the living reaches the ground.
Low as I am, you still cannot dodge me.
The target crouched down. Perfect.
Ready to devour ground prey!

lines.zh: 准备攻击地面上的目标！
lines.en: Ready to attack ground target!
Bite the ground enemy!
Ground creature, ready to eat!

lines.zh: 锁定地面目标，准备攻击！
lines.en: Ground target locked, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 地面行动目标，准备进食！
lines.en: Ground moving target, ready to eat!

lines.zh: 锁定地面行走者，准备攻击！
lines.en: Ground walker locked, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 地面活动目标，准备进食！
lines.en: Ground movement target, ready to eat!

lines.zh: 准备攻击地面上的敌人！
lines.en: Ready to attack ground enemies!

lines.zh: 锁定地面上的猎物，准备进食！
lines.en: Ground prey locked, ready to eat!

lines.zh: 我用肘部一点点撑过去。
lines.en: I push myself along on my elbows.

lines.zh: 指节在地面上磨得发白。
lines.en: My knuckles grind white on the ground.
I fix on your heel.
Wherever you go, I crawl.

lines.zh: 矮有矮的好处，你看不到。
lines.en: Being low has its uses. You cannot see me.
I stay below your line of sight.
Only half a breath is left in my throat.
I wait for you to bend down.
Crawling low to bite the ankle.
Crawl over, feel my teeth!
Rumble, digest your flesh!
Crunch, chew your bones!
Sssss, swallow your flesh!

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，往下拽。
lines.en: I bite your trouser cuff and pull down.
Crunch, munch on your bones!
Sssss, feast on you!
Rumble, gulp you down!
Crunch, digest you!
I clamp onto your bootlace and hold!
My nails rake your ankle!

lines.zh: 我抱住你的小腿往上爬！
lines.en: I hug your shin and climb!
My teeth clack against your greaves!
I ram your knee from below!
Once I drag you down, you are finished!
Rumble, here for you!
Sssss, come closer!
Crunch, ready now!
Sssss, your end!
Rumble, devour you!
Sssss, tear you apart!

lines.zh: 我贴着地爬，只到你的膝盖。
lines.en: I crawl at ground level, only to your knees.
Sssss, feast on you!
Rumble, enjoy!
Sssss, devour all!
I lift half a face out of the mud.
The grave soil loosens and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 只露出上半身，也够追你。
lines.en: Only my upper half shows, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 夜里的土坡上有了动静。
lines.en: Something stirs on the earthen slope at night.

lines.zh: 肌肉在颤抖...，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Muscles trembling — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我从石台上翻下来，脸先着地。
lines.en: I tumble off the ledge, face first.

lines.zh: 骨头在吱嘎响...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Bones creaking — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我快不行了...，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm about to collapse — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这太难了...，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: This is tough — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魔法打在我贴地的肚皮上。
lines.en: The spell struck my belly, flat against the ground.

lines.zh: 我要倒下了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm falling — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的肚皮爬过去。
lines.en: Lightning crawled along my belly.

lines.zh: 抓紧我...，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Hang on me — and the void makes it worse.
